verdict.rationale: NVIDIA markets the RTX 5080 as running the latest AI models locally and "fully private" on the user's PC, including with the user's own files. That implies user data stays on-device rather than going to a vendor who could train on it. The evidence never explicitly addresses training-data use, an opt-out control, or telemetry from NVIDIA software such as the NVIDIA app or G-Assist. missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data is not used for model training, a documented opt-out or telemetry control for NVIDIA software, and independent or hands-on verification of the privacy claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
